- Validate input: if arr is empty, return []; otherwise iterate once over arr with index to find even numbers.
- Track current best as tuple (value, index) initialized to None; for each element, if even (num % 2 == 0), update best if best is None or num < best.value, or num == best.value and index < best.index.
- After iteration, return [] if no even found; else return [best.value, best.index].
